listing.name: Burnout Revenge (Xbox 360) — burnout-revenge (secretpray)
listing.summary: The project describes racing and Crash modes on Apple Silicon. Its v0.1.25 notes mention controller-slot recovery, Xbox USB vibration, background My Music indexing and soundtrack recovery. This guide does not identify or confirm a new release package. Two physical local controllers and multiplayer between two Macs remain untested; Portcove has not confirmed gameplay or a complete playthrough. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Burnout Revenge (Xbox 360) Xbox 360 disc ISO. USA disc; European language import/add-ons optional.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Install macOS DMG and select own USA ISO for first-run import; European language/add-on imports are optional.
